raw.query:
WITH model_best AS (
  SELECT variate, resolution, model, MIN(wape) AS best_wape
  FROM forecast_metrics GROUP BY variate, resolution, model
)
SELECT mb1.variate, mb1.resolution,
       mb1.model AS classical, mb1.best_wape,
       mb2.model AS foundation, mb2.best_wape
FROM model_best mb1
JOIN model_best mb2 ON mb1.variate=mb2.variate AND mb1.resolution=mb2.resolution
WHERE mb1.model = 'ewma' AND mb2.model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto')
  AND mb1.best_wape < mb2.best_wape
ORDER BY mb1.variate, mb1.resolution, mb2.model
raw.observed: ewma beats all 3 FMs in ctx/1min (0.3827 vs 0.3848-0.3893) and images/1min (0.4793 vs 0.4826-0.4910); beats some FMs in ctx/30s, ctx/45s, gen/1min, gen/30s, gen/45s, requests/30s, requests/45s
raw.claimed: Three pretrained time-series foundation models beat every tested fixed-parameter classical baseline in all twenty (resolution, signal) cells
raw.evidence: ewma (classical) achieves lower WAPE than all 3 FMs in ctx/1min and images/1min cells, and beats at least 1 FM in 7 of the remaining 18 cells; only 11/20 cells show complete FM dominance
raw.fix: Restrict the claim to the cells where FMs unequivocally win (e.g. 15s/1s resolutions for ctx/gen/images/requests plus requests/1min), or acknowledge ewma wins at coarser resolutions where mean-reversion dominates
